# Inspect the xlsx file structure
library(readxl)
# Get sheet names
sheets <- excel_sheets("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
cat("Sheet names:\n")
print(sheets)
# Read each sheet's first few rows to understand structure
for (sheet in sheets) {
  cat("\n=== Sheet:", sheet, "===\n")
  df <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx", sheet = sheet, n_max = 5)
  cat("Columns:", paste(names(df), collapse=", "), "\n")
  cat("Dimensions:", dim(read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx", sheet = sheet)), "\n")
  print(head(df, 3))
}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
# Read full differential analysis data
de <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
cat("DE data dimensions:", dim(de), "\n")
cat("Columns:", names(de), "\n")
cat("\nSummary of log2FoldChange:\n")
print(summary(de$log2FoldChange))
cat("\nSummary of pvalue:\n")
print(summary(de$pvalue))
cat("\nMin/max pvalue:\n")
cat("Min:", min(de$pvalue, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
cat("Max:", max(de$pvalue, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
cat("\nDistribution of pvalue:\n")
print(table(cut(de$pvalue, breaks=c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1))))

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
# Read full differential analysis data
de <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
# Clean NA values and compute -log10(pvalue)
de_clean <- de %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue) & pvalue > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    negLog10P = -log10(pvalue),
    Significance = case_when(
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Up-regulated",
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )
cat("Total genes analyzed:", nrow(de), "\n")
cat("Genes after filtering NAs:", nrow(de_clean), "\n")
cat("Significance breakdown:\n")
print(table(de_clean$Significance))
# Show top up and down genes
cat("\nTop 10 up-regulated genes:\n")
print(head(de_clean %>% arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% select(id, log2FoldChange, pvalue), 10))
cat("\nTop 10 down-regulated genes:\n")
print(head(de_clean %>% arrange(log2FoldChange) %>% select(id, log2FoldChange, pvalue), 10))
cat("\nTop significant genes (lowest pvalue):\n")
print(head(de_clean %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% select(id, log2FoldChange, pvalue), 10))

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
# Read and prepare the differential analysis data
de <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
de_clean <- de %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue) & pvalue > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    negLog10P = -log10(pvalue),
    Significance = case_when(
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Up-regulated",
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    label = ifelse(
      (pvalue < 1e-50 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 5) | 
      (rank(pvalue) <= 15 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 4),
      id, NA_character_
    )
  )
cat("Prepared", nrow(de_clean), "genes for plotting\n")
# Generate the diagonal volcano plot
p <- ggplot(de_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = negLog10P, color = Significance)) +
  # Diagonal cutoff lines (V-shape) representing combined significance criteria
  geom_segment(aes(x = -7.7, xend = -1, y = -log10(0.05), yend = -log10(0.05)),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 14, y = -log10(0.05), yend = -log10(0.05)),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = -1, xend = -1, y = -log10(0.05), yend = max(de_clean$negLog10P) + 5),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = -log10(0.05), yend = max(de_clean$negLog10P) + 5),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up-regulated" = "#D6604D",
    "Down-regulated" = "#4393C3",
    "Not significant" = "grey75"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 14, 2), limits = c(-8, 14.5)) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey30",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot of Differential Expression",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Total genes: ", nrow(de_clean),
      "  |  Up-regulated: ", sum(de_clean$Significance == "Up-regulated"),
      "  |  Down-regulated: ", sum(de_clean$Significance == "Down-regulated")
    ),
    x = expression(log[2] ~ "Fold Change"),
    y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(p-value)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", size = 11),
    legend.position = c(0.88, 0.92),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6)
  ) +
  # Add annotation for thresholds
  annotate("text", x = -4.5, y = -log10(0.05) + 0.3, label = "p = 0.05",
           size = 3, color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = -1.15, y = max(de_clean$negLog10P) + 2,
           label = expression(log[2] ~ FC == -1), size = 3, color = "grey40", angle = 90) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.15, y = max(de_clean$negLog10P) + 2,
           label = expression(log[2] ~ FC == 1), size = 3, color = "grey40", angle = 90)
# Save as PDF
ggsave("volcano_plot.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("volcano_plot.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)
cat("Plot saved.\n")
print(p)
